listing.name: Valkyrie Profile 2: Silmeria — VP2S_Recomp (boubou666)
listing.summary: The project reaches the title, music, opening movie and first field cutscene, with corrupted field rendering at 25–35 VSync/s. It is not playable. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PAL SLES54645 ELF with SHA1 541fa8d563b2834350fd0a635a4d3631574ad778, plus the matching overlays and disc data.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s local source build using Ghidra, extraction, decryption of 25 overlays, recompilation and building. The first field still renders incorrectly; this is not a playable game.

warnings: The project reaches the title, music, opening movie and first field cutscene, with corrupted field rendering at 25–35 VSync/s. It is not playable.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
